summary: Agent that says it is an authorized sales agent for Thailand Privilege (formerly Thailand Elite) memberships and handles applications for 5 to 20 year visas.

facts.label: Agent licence
facts.value: States licence no. SA15/029 as a Thailand Privilege sales agent

facts.label: Membership fee
facts.value: 650,000 THB (Bronze, 5 years) to 5,000,000 THB (Reserve, 20 years), one-time
facts.quote: The Thailand Privilege Visa costs ฿650,000 (Bronze, 5 years) to ฿5,000,000 (Reserve, 20 years) as a one-time fee

facts.label: Payment timing
facts.value: Membership fee paid only after the background check is approved
facts.quote: You only pay the membership fee after your background check is approved by Thai authorities

facts.label: Processing time
facts.quote: the whole application process typically takes 6–8 weeks

facts.label: Annual extension
